commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git fetch --no-tags origin feat/outgoing-live-qa-20261125
test "$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/feat/outgoing-live-qa-20261125)" = "68664b6ff6174f504d85388de2b92b6237e34fb0"
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aicalls-outgoing-qa-XXXXXX)"
trap 'cd "$ROOT"; git worktree remove --force "$WORK" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
git worktree add --detach "$WORK" "68664b6ff6174f504d85388de2b92b6237e34fb0"
cd "$WORK"
echo "QA_SHA=68664b6ff6174f504d85388de2b92b6237e34fb0"
bash scripts/bin/test-profile.sh preflight
PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m unittest scripts.tests.test_audit_product_friction scripts.tests.test_docs_check scripts.tests.calls.test_outgoing_qa
bash scripts/bin/test-profile.sh focus app '*SupervisedTurnBackendTest'
bash scripts/bin/test-profile.sh focus app '*ChatRelayBackendTest'
bash scripts/bin/test-profile.sh focus app '*OutgoingQaSessionTest'
bash scripts/bin/test-profile.sh full
bash scripts/bin/test-profile.sh device-build
echo "OUTGOING_QA_HOST_PASS=true"
REPORT="$(mktemp /tmp/aicalls-outgoing-readiness-XXXXXX)"
if bash scripts/local_agent/device_readiness.sh >"$REPORT" 2>&1; then
  echo 'S22_READINESS_PASS=true'
else
  echo 'S22_READINESS_PASS=false'
fi
rm -f "$REPORT"
echo "QA_SHA=68664b6ff6174f504d85388de2b92b6237e34fb0"
